name: tavern-iq
description: TavernIQ - AI-powered VOD coaching for Hearthstone Battlegrounds

scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm --prefix apps/server run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
